summary: Feed s100_single to IDS is degraded due to 7.7% duplicate packets (159/2059, threshold 5%). All other checks healthy: no one-way traffic, no packet drops, no tool overload, no missing VLANs, and encrypted share within tolerance.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packet twice, most likely aggregating both sides of a link (SPAN RX+TX or dual TAPs) without deduplication. Same 5-tuple/sequence seen twice within short window.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes CPU and state table on duplicate packets, inflates flow counts, risks duplicate alerts and inaccurate detection analytics while still receiving both directions and full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets within dedup window before delivery to IDS, eliminating 7.7% overhead without losing coverage. No other broker changes needed as drops, overload, VLAN and encryption are healthy.
